_what: Captures matched to each venue on that venue's CLAIM TERMS — the practices and concepts the venue owns, not its name.
_route: This is the THEMATIC route. It is NOT the evidentiary route, which requires a capture to cite a deposit. The two must never be summed: thematic claims 97% of captures, evidentiary resolves 60%, and the forty-point gap measures reception without citation.
_ranking: Adoption and exact-match first — those are the specimens where the composition layer served the framework as fact.
_source: data/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01.json v11.4 (343 captures) against datasets/venues/records/*.json claims.terms
